stories.name_fr: Engagement contractuel Anthropic sur sept ans
stories.name_en: Anthropic contractual commitment over seven years
stories.explanation: Engagement pour l’infrastructure d’IA distribuée d’Akamai Cloud.
stories.story_fr: Akamai annonce un engagement contractuel de 11,6 milliards de dollars d’Anthropic sur sept ans.
stories.story_en: Akamai announces an $11.6 billion contractual commitment from Anthropic over seven years.
stories.citation: today announced a significantly expanded relationship with Anthropic for $11.6 billion of contractual commitment over seven years

stories.name_en: Potential expansion of the Anthropic commitment
stories.explanation: Montant supplémentaire possible, soit environ 20 Mds $ au total.
stories.story_fr: Le contrat prévoit une extension possible jusqu’à 9 milliards de dollars supplémentaires, soit environ 20 milliards de dollars au total.
stories.story_en: The agreement allows a further expansion of up to $9 billion, for a total potential commitment of about $20 billion.
stories.citation: potential expansion of the relationship by up to an additional $9 billion, which represents a total potential commitment of approximately $20 billion

stories.name_en: Capital expenditures tied to the Anthropic commitment
stories.story_fr: Akamai estime à environ 5,5 milliards de dollars les investissements liés à cet engagement de 11,6 milliards.
stories.story_en: Akamai estimates capital expenditures tied to the $11.6 billion commitment at about $5.5 billion.
stories.citation: Total capital expenditures related to today’s $11.6 billion commitment are estimated to be approximately $5.5 billion

stories.explanation: Achats anticipés de composants dont la mémoire.
stories.story_fr: Akamai prévoit une hausse d’environ 1,7 milliard de dollars de ses investissements en 2026 pour sécuriser des composants, dont la mémoire.
stories.story_en: Akamai expects about $1.7 billion of additional capital expenditures in 2026 to secure components, including memory.
stories.citation: an increase of approximately $1.7 billion in capital expenditures in 2026 to secure and pre-purchase critical supply chain components, including memory

positionnement_ia.detail: Akamai Cloud est présenté comme plateforme d’infrastructure pour charges de travail d’IA et agents.
positionnement_ia.citation: Akamai Cloud supports a continuum of compute from core to edge

ignores.raison: instrument financier, pas un chiffre d’usage

ignores.quoi: Plus de 2,8 Mds $ d’engagements CIS précédents
